0022600172.text: The Miami Heat (2-4, 10th in the East and 4th in the Southeast, 1 game back) visit the Los Angeles Lakers (4-2, 1st in the Pacific and 7th in the West), who lost their most recent game, while the Heat have won their last two. The teams met twice in the 2025-26 season series, which the Heat lost 0-2, most recently on March 19, 2026 in Miami, a 134-126 Heat loss, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 season series. Tim Hardaway Jr. is day-to-day for the Heat with a personal reason and is a game-time decision, while the Lakers will be without Adou Thiero (out, knee inflammation) and Ziaire Williams (out, foot).
